// Probe for tests/unit/document-gate-before-model.test.ts — RED. A brand cast
// outside lib/ingestion/validated-document.ts forges a gate verdict. Expected
// finding: one forged brand, in forgedProbe.
import type { ValidatedAIDocument } from "@/lib/ingestion/validated-document"
import { getAIService } from "@/lib/services/ai"

export async function forgedProbe(data: string) {
    const document = { data, mimeType: "application/pdf" } as ValidatedAIDocument
    return getAIService().extractPolicyData(document)
}
